children: ICICI Securities's research report on Metropolis Healthcare

Metropolis’ Q2FY27 performance was boosted by a strong uptick in specialty tests, which fuelled 11% growth in test volumes and an ~5% jump in revenue per test (RPT). EBITDA margin expansion of 180bps YoY was supported by higher utilisation of its established lab network and productivity improvement initiatives. The integration of Core is progressing well and its EBITDA margins have scaled to double digit. Metropolis’ presence has also strengthened in oncology and genomics testing. Management revised its FY27 revenue growth guidance to ~16% (earlier 14–15%) and EBITDA margin is expected to expand 160–180bps in H2FY27. The company may look to hike its B2C test prices in Q4FY27. We raise FY27E EPS by ~3%, baking in better margins. Retain BUY; DCF-based TP of INR 675 is unchanged.

The stock currently trades at valuations of 44.0x FY27E and 36.1x FY28E earnings and EV/EBITDA multiple of 23.4x FY27E and 19.4x FY28E. We maintain BUY on the stock with an unchanged DCF-based target price of INR 675.
